REL='tests/integration/lib/db/migrations/test_65f53650f3a8_quality_profile_publication.py'
original=(ROOT/REL).read_bytes()
old=b'    assert script.get_heads() == [REVISION]\n'
new=b'    heads = script.get_heads()\n    assert len(heads) == 1\n    assert REVISION in {item.revision for item in script.walk_revisions(base="base", head=heads[0])}\n'
assert original.count(old)==1

(W/'a3-migration-test-proposed.py').write_bytes(proposed)
REV='65f53650f3a8';PRE='918c4a0e0001'

 node=next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='test_exact_singleton_head_and_predecessor')
 tree=ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[])
 ns={'ScriptDirectory':ScriptDirectory,'Config':Config,'Path':Path,'REVISION':REV,'PREDECESSOR':PRE}
 exec(compile(tree,'exact-historical-head-test','exec'),ns)

 except AssertionError:return False
 return True
